scenarios.name: Revenge Run
scenarios.subtitle: Floor 01 workshop lane: a parked machine wakes behind you, run for the tunnel
scenarios.purpose: A 1344 px scrolling chase with one flat ground lane: a protected entry pocket at the rear gate, a clear chase lane, the machine's stop line at x 1000 and a low tunnel whose lintel stops the machine while both heroes walk under it to the exit.
scenarios.expected: The machine and the tunnel lintel come from f01_dozer.encounter.json; this file holds geometry only. The lane ceiling is declared for the tunnel lintel and the stop frame of DR-B.
scenarios.coop: Solo with a swap, or two players: the only route is the flat lane; no Donut-only gate and no raised surface.
